Browser extension bullets for v1.4.0, to be merged into `v1.4.0.md`.

## 🔒 Privacy

- **The browser extension no longer asks for access to all websites when you install it.** It asks when you switch Click'n'Load on, and you can say no. Switching Click'n'Load off gives the access back.
- **Sending needs no website access.** A page, a link, an image or a selection is read from the tab only when you click the extension's button or pick one of its right-click entries.
- **After the update, Click'n'Load may ask once more.** If your browser dropped the access the extension got at install, the options page opens with a card that asks for it again in one click. Chrome and Edge keep it, so nothing changes there.

## 🧹 Removed

- **The start and stop buttons are gone from the extension's instance cards.** The extension catches and sends links. Run the queue from the web interface, the app or the desktop tray. A card still shows whether its instance is online and what the queue is doing, and opens its web interface.

## 🎨 Design

- **The extension's instance cards say Connected and Not connected**, as the web interface and the app do.

## 📋 Notes

- On Firefox for Android the extension needs version 142 or later. On desktop Firefox it stays at 140.
